reading.action: Return to the shaft (The Ascending Dark) and work up the broken flights + moving slabs toward the exit.

check.note: MASTERFUL. Hiker's Legs (leg-driven intent bonus) + scouted beat (t56) + light solved (oil-lantern lit by his ember) + INT 20 reading the rhythm -> a clean, low-cost ascent to the mid-shaft. Stalker already dead (t58); danger was the fall, not combat.

reading.result: CLIMB to the mid-shaft (masterful). Lit the base oil-lantern with his ember (light solved); flowed up the broken flights and timed the slab-leaps cleanly. Reached the MID-SHAFT corpse: claimed the HOODED LANTERN (directional, won't blind him) + read the NOTE (REVEALS a warden at the headworks tied to the chain/counterweight; trails off on a partial clue). Glimpsed the gantry mass far above but NO clear Colossus read yet (not a crit). COSTS: Stamina 76->62, Focus 114->111, HP 124 (no scrape). No XP/skill/affinity tick. GEAR +Hooded lantern (lit), +Climber's note; base oil-lantern left burning as a beacon. STOP at the mid-shaft — exit far above, slabs still moving, a guardian now KNOWN above. NO assumed press-on. NO Tower reset.
